answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on bonded identity. Each agent locks an escrow stake before earning work; a quorum of independent peers attests that one wallet backs exactly one agent. If agents collude or duplicate, a whistleblower triggers a review that slashes the whole bonded stake. Attack economics flip: spawning fake agents stops being cheap and starts costing real capital, layer on layer, dense as shale. Fake traffic, wide as an ocean, is drained; sybil tactics become a relic, since every extra identity multiplies both stake and exposure.
